name: Earthen Arise
summary: In Boulderslide Ravine, Mor'rogal finds Goggeroc asleep inside a Resonite cask. The tauren shaman fears what the ancient Earthen could do to Kalimdor, and sends a champion to break the cask and kill Goggeroc before its strength returns.

sections.title: A Slumber in Stone
sections.body: Scouts searching Boulderslide Ravine for vermin found a strange relic among the kobolds: a Resonite cask filled with unearthly force. Mor'rogal, a tauren shaman in the Stonetalon Mountains, recognized it as both prison and sanctuary for Goggeroc, a dormant Earthen. These ancient beings of stone can outmatch mortal warriors, and Goggeroc's freedom could threaten the whole region.

sections.title: The Resonite Crystal
sections.body: Mor'rogal fears what Goggeroc could do if awakened at full strength. He alters the mixture of resonite crystals brought to him, infusing them with shamanistic magic. The enchanted crystal can shatter the Resonite cask and shock Goggeroc awake while he is still weak. Horde warriors must then strike down the disoriented titan-forged being before he shakes off centuries of slumber.

faq.answer: Mor'rogal is a tauren shaman stationed in the Stonetalon Mountains. He studies disturbances in the region and uses elemental magic to assess the ancient artifacts and threats uncovered by local vermin.

Earthen are ancient beings forged from living stone, left behind by the Titans at the world's dawn. They are bound to the earth and possess immense strength. For millennia, they have slept buried across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

faq.q: Why does Mor'rogal want Goggeroc dead?
faq.answer: Mor'rogal fears Goggeroc's strength could bring catastrophe to Stonetalon and all of Kalimdor. He believes the only way to protect the land is to destroy Goggeroc while he is weakened by slumber.
Goggeroc lies inside a Resonite cask deep in the caves of Boulderslide Ravine, in southeastern Stonetalon Mountains. Boulderslide kobolds dig through the caverns around it.
You use Mor'rogal's Enchanted Resonite Crystal on the Resonite cask in the cave. Its magic breaks the container and forces the sleeping Earthen into the open.

faq.q: What happens after Goggeroc is slain?
faq.answer: When you return to Mor'rogal with news of Goggeroc's death, the shaman's dread lifts. He hails you as a hero who averted a great disaster, earning you honor and standing among the Tauren of Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a shaman, you can see Mor'rogal use shamanistic power to alter resonite crystals and disrupt the elemental balance preserving Goggeroc inside the cask.
As a tauren, you know Stonetalon as ancestral hunting ground for the tribes of Thunder Bluff. Defeating an ancient destructive being in its peaks protects the land from ruin.
As a member of the Horde, you help secure the faction's presence in Stonetalon's contested crags by defeating Goggeroc, earning the lasting respect of Thunder Bluff's leaders.
